plan.requires: Sentence-holdout pilot v1 finished and reported before this run starts
plan.question: With familiar readers and new sentence blocks kept apart from training in list order, does real EEG beat noise, shuffled pairs, word-count/timing and list-position controls?

split.unit: Contiguous block of the stimulus list, separately for each release
split.list_order: Sentence ID order. Assumed to match presentation order; not verified against stimulus logs
split.buffer_policy: Buffer sentences are used in no fit and no score
split.placement: Seeded rejection sampling, zuco1 then zuco2. Blocks hold no sentence that repeats in its list, occurs in both releases or has a near-duplicate, and keep at least the buffer length between blocks; neighbouring buffers may overlap
split.near_duplicate_policy: Sentences with a near-duplicate or list repeat never enter held-out blocks; training also drops any group found in a held-out block as a safeguard

V.normalizer: Shared across readers, fit on training observations only

F.purpose: Validity fixes plus fuller input, tested together
F.window: Whole sentence, center crop only above 30 seconds
F.normalizer: Per reader, fit on that reader's training observations only

ridge.selection: Highest validation primary metric; first grid entry on ties

cnn.seed_aggregation: Mean per-query score across seeds before the gate

shared_controls.timing_only_ridge: Observation duration, word count and a training-derived word-count basis; no EEG amplitudes

position_only_ridge.input: Release flag and Fourier basis of normalized list position; no EEG amplitudes

evaluation.aggregation: Mean within reader, then equal weight across 30 readers

primary.metric: Expected 10-way top-1 accuracy with uniform random distractors; chance 10%
primary.candidate_pool: All sentences in the same split and release; 50 sentences

within_block.candidate_pool: The 25 sentences of the query's own block

secondary: Expected 10-way accuracy among the 20 candidates closest in word count
Correlation of EEG-predicted list position with true position on validation
evaluation.ties: A tie with the correct sentence counts as a miss

gate.scope: Applied separately to ridge V, ridge F and CNN F on validation
gate.bootstrap: 10000 resamples; 98.33% lower bounds above zero for real minus Gaussian when resampling readers and when resampling sentences

plan.test_policy: Score a model and its matched controls once on test blocks only if that model passes the gate; otherwise never score test blocks
plan.stop_rule: Stop after this run whatever the outcome. No extra settings or architectures under this plan.
plan.existing_output_policy: Refuse to run if the output directory exists; hash protected prior artifacts before and after
